changelog:
后台收货与稳定性修复（1.6.3）

🔔 锁屏且「锁屏持续接收」开启时保持 CPU 唤醒；实时唤醒断流 50 秒内自动重连，锁屏消息到达更稳定。
⚙️ 接收页新增「锁屏持续接收（更耗电）」开关（默认开），可关闭以省电。
🛡️ 关闭监听后不再转发来电与短信；新增「仅转发电话与短信」独立开关（默认关）。
🧯 数据库打不开时不再一律当作损坏重建：只有确认损坏才恢复，其它错误明确报错并可重试，历史不再被误清空。
🎨 统一弹窗、取消色、卡片阴影、底栏、输入框与开关等细节。
changelogEn:
Background delivery and reliability fixes (1.6.3)

🔔 While the screen is off and "keep receiving while locked" is on, the CPU stays awake; a silent real-time channel reconnects within 50 seconds, so lock-screen delivery is steadier.
⚙️ New "keep receiving while locked (more battery)" switch in the receiving page, on by default; turn it off to save power.
🛡️ Turning monitoring off now stops call and SMS forwarding; a separate "forward calls and SMS only" switch (off by default) is available.
🧯 An unopenable database is no longer treated as corrupt and rebuilt: only confirmed corruption enters recovery, other errors are reported with Retry, so history is not silently wiped.
🎨 Unified dialogs, cancel colour, card shadows, bottom bar, inputs and switches.
